name: website-build
title_zh: 从 WordPress 到静态站，整站重建不换魂
tagline_zh: 接手乱糟糟的旧站，先做发现再选栈，最后交付能过 WCAG 的生产级营销站。迁移 Shopify、Wix 也不慌。
tagline_en: Turns messy WordPress/Webflow sites into clean, accessible marketing sites. Discovery first, then stack choice.
desc_en: Build or rebuild a production marketing website — discovery, stack and provider selection, then the build. Use when asked to create, rebuild, migrate or redesign a website for a business, or when migrating off WordPress, Elementor, Bricks, Divi, WPBakery, Webflow, Squarespace, Wix or Shopify. Also use when asked whether a site meets WCAG, ADA, the EAA, Section 508 or AODA, or to audit or fix its a
why_zh: 不是套模板，而是先摸清业务再定技术栈；自带无障碍合规审计，重建后直接达标，省掉返工。
why_en: Starts with business discovery, not templates; bakes in accessibility compliance so the rebuild passes audits without extra.
limit_zh: 只覆盖营销类网站，不接电商交易、会员系统或复杂 Web 应用；需要你提供现有站点访问权限或内容导出；产物是静态站点。
limit_en: Marketing sites only—no ecommerce, memberships, or complex web apps. Needs access to existing site or content export. Output is static, no backend.
title_en: Full website rebuild from legacy CMS to modern static
